subject: general
question: When was IFCI (Industrial Finance Corporation of India Ltd.) set up as a statutory corporation to provide medium and long-term finance to the industry?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1948 **__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Industrial Finance Corporation of India Ltd. (IFCI)__

 __
 
• IFCI is one of the oldest development banks in India, primarily focused on providing financial assistance for industrial development.
 
• The organization plays a significant role in promoting entrepreneurship and supporting large-scale projects across various sectors.
 
• Rahul Bhave has been recommended for the position of MD & CEO at Industrial Finance Corporation of India Ltd. (IFCI).
 
• Palash Srivastava has been recommended for the Deputy Managing Director position at India Infrastructure Finance Company Limited (IIFCL).
 
• FSIB is responsible for recruiting chairpersons of public sector banks, insurers, and financial institutions.
 
• These recommendations are part of FSIB's mandate to ensure effective leadership in financial institutions.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Financial Services Institutions Bureau (FSIB)__

 
 
• FSIB is a government body responsible for the recruitment and recommendation of leadership positions in financial institutions.
 
• The bureau aims to enhance governance and operational efficiency in the financial sector through effective leadership appointments.
